proof: For $n=1$, the empty sample is allowed and contains no negative example, giving value zero. For $n\ge2$, the positive teacher $\{i\}\mapsto\{(i,1)\}$ is non-clashing. A width-zero teacher assigns the empty sample to every target and creates a clash, so the positive no-clashing value is one.
name: Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of Singletons
